text_block_list.text:
When I came to the classroom to pick up 
Grass Wonder so we could begin training—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I'm so sorry for making you 
come all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, would it be alright if I took 
today off from training...?
choice_data_list: Are you feeling unwell or something?
Are you feeling unwell or something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not quite that... I am in 
perfectly good health, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Grass-cha~n! What does 
"kotoshigeshi" mean~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair! I was going to ask my English 
question first!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right away, I'll be there in just a 
moment~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer. So that's how it 
is."

And so, Grass Wonder apologized and took 
her leave with an apologetic look.
